reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
paid AS (  -- one row per cohort user and month with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 0 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 1 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 2 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 3 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) END AS m3
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY c.cohort_month

       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 3 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) FILTER (WHERE p.month_offset = 3) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) END AS m3

LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.user_id = c.user_id

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
flags AS (  -- one row per cohort user, 1 for each month offset with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p0,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p2,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p3
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY c.user_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(p0), 1) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * AVG(p1), 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * AVG(p2), 1) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * AVG(p3), 1) END AS m3
FROM flags
GROUP BY cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', signup_ts)) AS DATE) AS cm FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
sz AS (SELECT cm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c GROUP BY cm),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cm, c.user_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cm, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', pay.paid_at)) AS DATE)) AS mo
  FROM c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments pay ON pay.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT pay.refunded
)
SELECT sz.cm AS cohort_month,
       CASE WHEN sz.cm >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.user_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mo = 0) / sz.n, 1) END AS m0,
       CASE WHEN CAST(sz.cm + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.user_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mo = 1) / sz.n, 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN CAST(sz.cm + INTERVAL 2 MONTH AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.user_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mo = 2) / sz.n, 1) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN CAST(sz.cm + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.user_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mo = 3) / sz.n, 1) END AS m3
FROM sz LEFT JOIN p ON p.cm = sz.cm
GROUP BY sz.cm, sz.n
